title: 2.5 Adaptation and Mitigation Strategies to Climate Change
description: UNFCCC response strategies, adaptation types, Ethiopian practices and mitigation measures. Easy level.

questions.question: Which two response strategies does the UNFCCC highlight?
What does mitigation aim to do?
options: Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change
Protecting forests, soils and oceans that store carbon
By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
questions.correctAnswer: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks

questions.question: What does adaptation aim to do?
options: Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
Protecting forests, soils and oceans that store carbon
By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
questions.correctAnswer: Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change

questions.question: Which strategy has historically received more attention?
Which is a common adaptation strategy in Ethiopia?
Which practice involves collecting rainwater for later use?
What is growing a wider variety of crops called?
What is reactive adaptation?
options: It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
It eases impacts but does not limit the underlying climate change
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
questions.correctAnswer: Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred

questions.question: What is anticipatory adaptation?
options: Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
Cutting fossil fuel use for electricity, heat and transport
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
questions.correctAnswer: Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
